summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 9, 2026 press release reporting Q3 2026 gold production from its Blanket Mine in Zimbabwe and revised FY 2026 guidance. Q3 output fell to 17,030 ounces from 19,106 ounces a year earlier, with nine-month production of 49,158 ounces versus 58,846 ounces. Management cut FY 2026 guidance to 69,000-72,500 ounces from 72,000-76,500 ounces, citing delayed compressor deliveries and metallurgical plant commissioning issues. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation; watch compressor deployment and Q4 recovery for guidance risk.
